name: latex-renderer-local
description: Render local LaTeX projects through LaTeX Renderer from Claude Desktop.
long_description: A local stdio MCP server for explicitly selected LaTeX files, directories, and ZIP projects. The server uploads source through the existing sandboxed renderer and downloads artifacts to the local machine.

tools.name: upload_source
tools.description: Prepare one explicitly selected local directory or ZIP as a Source.

tools.name: create_render_job
tools.description: Create one Job from a Source and explicit entrypoint.

tools.name: render_project
tools.description: Render one explicitly selected local project.

tools.name: download_render_artifacts
tools.description: Download artifacts to an explicit local directory.

tools.name: cancel_render
tools.description: Cancel an owned Job after user confirmation.

tools.name: delete_render
tools.description: Delete an owned terminal Job after user confirmation.

api_key.title: LaTeX Renderer API key
api_key.description: Rendering key beginning with lrk_. It is injected only into the local MCP server process.
